findings.title: Materials' 64-point lens gap signals earnings collapse
findings.body: Materials trades at 16.17x forward but 34.42x trailing, a 53 percent compression that implies 113 percent earnings growth. That gap is the widest in the table, and the market is pricing a near-doubling of profits that the trailing multiple does not support.

findings.title: Energy's month-long slide leaves trailing rich
findings.body: Energy's forward percentile dropped 18 points in a month to 44, yet its trailing P/E sits at the 81st percentile. The 37-point gap between lenses means the market has already discounted a 52 percent earnings rebound, leaving little room for disappointment.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' forward percentile collapses to 9
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward percentile fell 19 points in a month to 9, while its trailing percentile holds at 53. The 44-point gap implies analysts expect a 39 percent earnings surge, a bold bet for a defensive sector that has historically delivered steady, not explosive, growth.
